This isn't a bug. It's the design. — agentic browser's entire job is to read and act on untrusted content, with your identity, wired into your machine. You can't patch away the reason the product exists. — So — slide 177 of 179

Asking the model to behave is not a security control. — Soft boundaries, alignment and "ask before acting," slowed us down and never stopped us. Only hard, in-code boundaries held, and even those we bypassed. — So — slide 178 of 179

It's a class problem, so the fix is architectural, and until it ships, the burden is on you. — No single vendor owns this and no single patch closes it, especially when the response is "expected behavior." — So — slide 179 of 179
